text_block_list.text:
Midday on a day off. Feeling hungry, I was
strolling through the shopping district looking for a place to eat—

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: It's all overrr!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"No, no, I'm fi—
Huh? Trainer?"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see... apparently a bunch of new shops
have opened in the neighborhood recently.
At this rate, they might have to close down...

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
"An old-fashioned diner like this just won't cut it anymore...
It needs to be trendy enough to capture the appetites of young folks..."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
......No~ope!
It's not over just yet!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Because... on my pride as a diner girl!
Emergency temporary poster girl plus brilliant consultant,
O-Machi-chan is going to save this restaurant!
choice_data_list: If that's the case, we need a strategy.
If that's the case, we'll need a plan.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, I've got that completely covered!
Namely... 'Operation: Mega-Insta-Worthy Menu Boost'!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
If customers are flocking to new things, we'll fight back
with a new menu! We shall serve innovative, stylish dishes
that look amazing on Umastagram!

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: "Doing that is completely useless...! It's just a drop in the ocean! I'm nothing but a loser...!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, let's just give it everything we've got!
Come on, everyone together!
Ei, ei, mun!

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text: Mmmrrgh!!" any
And so, Matikanetannhauser set to work developing an "Insta-worthy menu." And a few days later, her very first customer—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me. ...Excuse meee?
...Is this shop open?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Welcome~!
Come on in~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Tannhauser?
What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, well, let's put that aside for now...
First, please take a look
at our shop's proud photo-worthy menu!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"...'Firecracker Riot Fry', 'Heaven and Hell Earth Roast',
'High-Spec Master'...
Wait, what kind of food is that!? Is it even food!?"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Um, I don't really know anything about this...
Well, just give me your recommendation for now...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting~
Here is your "Three-Meal Super Stamina Runaway Train"~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Liver and chives?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
And here we have the "Lava Flow Tofu Archipelago"
and the "Dark Matter Sizzling Stir-Fry."

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
............
Mapo tofu... and sweet and sour pork?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on, hold on, hold ooon!
This is all just regular Chinese food, isn't it?!
The names are the only bizarre thing here!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... That's why I tried to help save the shop
by coming up with some innovative menu names,
which was great, but...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
As a diner owner's daughter, I couldn't take too big of a risk on the flavor, so it just ended up being a simple variation on the menu...
Quite the dilemma, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I guess I really can't
break out of my ordinary shell after all~

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, don't be so pessimistic.
Let's eat what's been prepared for us first, and then we can come up with a new plan—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: *Munch, munch*... Wait, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
So good! This is insanely delicious!
It totally blew past my expectations...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
That's right... you're not just ordinary!
You can do it, Tannhauser!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
I-Indeed, with a flavor like this...
this shop will be revitalized!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
R-Really...!?
Are you for real...!
choice_data_list: You've broken out of your "ordinary" shell!
You've broken out of your "ordinary" shell, haven't you!
All that's left is to build up our name.
All that's left is to build up our name.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
R-Really...!?
Are you for real...!
choice_data_list: You've broken out of your "ordinary" shell!
You've broken out of your "ordinary" shell, haven't you!
All that's left is to build up our name.
All that's left is to build up our name.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, no, no... I was just making it
while remembering the home-cooked flavor from back home...
choice_data_list: Then you have your parents to thank.
Then you have your parents to thank, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
You're right. All right.
Then I'll turn toward home
and offer a prayer of gratitude.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Mom and Dad...
And my little brother too, so he doesn't feel left out...
And... thanks to Nice Nature promoting the shop on social media, customers started returning, successfully saving the business.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Mumu. True, first we have to get people to eat it, right~?

text_block_list.name: Chinese Restaurant Owner
text_block_list.text:
...I know! How about we use our poster girl O-Machi-chan to draw in customers?!
Like a local town mascot!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I see! Then, then,
let's put on some wings for now...
and say we were born from the sea—

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
N-No, I don't want it, I don't want it!
Besides, you're contradicting yourself right out the gate!
I got the feeling that the stubborn old man was part of the reason the diner was failing in the first place, but either way, the new menu was a hit and the place was saved.
